n: 'You the Past, Ward Me Firmly' stages opened
'You the Constant, You Are Me' stages opened

missions: Clear event stages 15 times, not including tutorial stages.
Clear event stages 45 times, not including tutorial stages.
Clear event stages 85 times, not including tutorial stages.

theme: A room modeled after the Scar Market based on the Sarkaz mercenaries' descriptions. The market was known for its disorder and disarray. Its visual appearance was established by a Cyclops who had been in charge for several decades.

list:
You have reviewed everything about Babel that has survived until now.
Rhodes Island continues its arduous march forward, both to keep the torrents of history from washing it back to that bygone era, and to save even more lives.
During the Babel event, obtain Operator Odda.

You reunited with an old subordinate.
The two of you once spent a long time together, and he is prepared to walk with you toward the future once more.
During the Babel event, consume 2,400 Raw Sugar Lumps.

You retook stock of your resources from the Babel era.
Even in a time when resources are plentiful, not a single bar of Pure Gold or speck of grain is ever wasted.
Complete all stages in [You the Future, Take My Gifts] with 3-star ratings (excluding tutorials).

You witnessed the history of Babel where a belief triumphed over another.
She had faith in you. She believed in your aspirations, and trusted that your ideals would stand the test of time.
Complete all the content in [The King's Calls to Arms] and collect the rewards.

You analyzed the circumstances of Kazdel's civil war.
The purest ideals clash with one another, leading to the gravest of tragedies.
Clear BB-8 with a 3-star rating using Stabilizer Chains to silence Deathveil Assassin at least twice.

You wandered through the landship trying to recreate the scene you saw that day.
Struggle and suffering are like a silent howl echoing between each and every command.
Clear BB-MO-1 with a 3-star rating triggering the effects of Stabilizer Chains at least 10 times.

You inspected this enormous ship and your companions once more.
This time, you are free.
Complete all stages in [You the Past, Ward Me Firmly] on Challenge Mode.

You found this medal among your past collection.
The glory is frozen in the past, but the responsibility has never faded.
Complete all stages in [You the Constant, You Are Me] on Challenge Mode (except BB-MO-1).

The highest medal awarded by Babel, one once bestowed to you.
Time did not leave its mark on this shiny medal, nor has it diluted the expectations it represents.
Clear BB-EX-7 with a 3-star rating, and allied units are inflicted with Unsteady no more than 3 times.

You viewed the records of the Babel commander who earned the title 'Evil Spirit.'
Accurate, decisive, machine-like efficiency. Cold, emotionless, and intimidating.
set:
An engraved medal set chronicling Babel's inception to its downfall.
When history becomes stories, stories become legends, and legends are nearly forgotten by the masses...
Do not forget.
